ORIGINAL SOURCE QUEUE. Current file differs from the historical commit: the TASK-20260731-002 archive block's commit_sha/parent_sha/path_sha256 were null/{} historically and were filled in 2026-08-29 with an 'archive_repair_note' -- independently re-verified against git as CORRECT (matches actual commit_sha/parent_sha/hashes). The TASK-20260731-004 archive block's commit_sha/parent_sha/path_sha256 remain null/{} in BOTH historical and current versions (deliberately left unrepaired), with a 'diagnosis_note' added in the current version only. THE FROZEN FIRST DEFECT NAMED IN intake.md ('non-archive task TASK-20260731-001 is assigned to both TASK-20260731-002 and TASK-20260731-004') IS STILL PRESENT in the current file: TASK-20260731-002.archive.source_task_ids=['TASK-20260731-001'] and TASK-20260731-004.archive.source_task_ids=['TASK-20260731-001','TASK-20260731-003'] both list TASK-20260731-001. This defect is recorded here exactly as found; it is NOT waived, softened, or resolved by this task.

UNRELATED GOAL-MLKEM-002 EXTRA DIFF named in the batch objective: this file appears in the git diff of commit 5298c29a29ce... against its parent 6c6fce7d3389... (independently confirmed via `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r 6c6fce7d3389... 5298c29a29ce...`), i.e. it was touched by the same commit as the snapshot002 archive despite being scientifically unrelated to GOAL-CRYPTO-001/BATCH-013. Historical and current bytes are byte-identical (sha256 cac7eb23...2aac70) -- the file has not changed since that commit.

OLD EXACT-DIFF FAILURE, NOT WAIVED: current file differs from the historical committed blob in fields that were retroactively edited after the commit. (1) parent_sha: historical committed value is 'bd10a8f231d439d1ad918c31761bf41d283b915c', which IS the true first parent of commit 281a70a3cb... (independently verified via `git rev-list --parents -n1 281a70a3cb...`). The CURRENT file instead reads parent_sha='27ef824afe59fda596734ee070703e6a4aac11c8', which is a real, reachable commit object but is NOT the first parent of 281a70a3cb... -- this is a wrong/mismatched parent_sha introduced after the fact. (2) commit_sha: historical was null (unfilled stub); current fills it to '281a70a3cb0bbc9b75121330ab590e150f8cd402', which IS this commit's own correct sha. (3) artifact_sha256['ledger/goals/GOAL-CRYPTO-001.yaml']: historical committed value is '6cde05e8d5aa686045df31d32ffd95c9718aa751bd79e87e550cb08767adb21e', which MATCHES the actual git blob for that path at that commit (independently recomputed via `git show 281a70a3cb...:ledger/goals/GOAL-CRYPTO-001.yaml | sha256sum`). The CURRENT file instead reads '6a44f65becaf8266de6a1357d84228c800b52cf7a9a857295b545306a371c154', which does NOT match the actual git blob at that commit and does NOT match the current working-tree file either. This is an exact-diff (hash) failure: a repair pass changed a correct historical hash to an incorrect one for GOAL-CRYPTO-001.yaml while leaving other fields (falsification_review.md, red_team_report.yaml, DEC-20260731-002.yaml, EV-CRYPTO-013.yaml hashes) untouched and correct. Recorded exactly as found; not corrected or waived by this task.

GOAL LEDGER RECORD. Current working-tree bytes are NOT identical to the historical committed blob at 281a70a3cb... (expected: the goal file has been legitimately amended many times since 2026-07-31, e.g. budget amendments, the 2026-08-18 hold-audit note, and the 2026-09-07 integrity_recovery_20260907 block). Historical committed sha256=6cde05e8d5aa686045df31d32ffd95c9718aa751bd79e87e550cb08767adb21e; current working-tree sha256=02865c12dbbddb105efe8d05f9a0ae2f26db1f3132ee63060e99a2426e6defa7. Separately (see the ledger-receipt.json entry above), the ledger-receipt.json's OWN declared artifact_sha256 for this exact historical revision is WRONG (does not match either the historical git blob or the current file) -- that mismatch is the old exact-diff failure, reported there, not here.

It has not been collapsed to a single owner.

controls.compare_all_original_hashes_before_and_a: Performed: every git-recovered blob's sha256 was independently recomputed with `git show <rev>:<path> | sha256sum` and cross-checked against (a) the value declared in the corresponding receipt/queue file where one exists and (b) the current working-tree file's own sha256. Mismatches are called out explicitly in recovered_entries[].mapping_or_content_difference rather than silently resolved.
controls.independent_git_blob_comparison: Performed via `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r <parent> <commit>` for both target commits, cross-checked against the file sets in source-git-evidence.json's 'diff' block and against the artifact_sha256 keys in each receipt.

intentional_bad_hash_path_map_rejection_.description: A deliberately wrong (parent_sha, path->hash) mapping was tested against the real git objects to confirm the recovery method rejects fabricated mappings rather than accepting them on trust.
intentional_bad_hash_path_map_rejection_.test: Constructed the claim 'ledger-receipt.json's declared parent_sha 27ef824afe59fda596734ee070703e6a4aac11c8 is the first parent of commit 281a70a3cb0bbc9b75121330ab590e150f8cd402' and checked it against `git rev-list --parents -n1 281a70a3cb0bbc9b75121330ab590e150f8cd402`.
intentional_bad_hash_path_map_rejection_.result: REJECTED: git's actual first parent is bd10a8f231d439d1ad918c31761bf41d283b915c, not 27ef824a.... The bad mapping was not accepted; the discrepancy is reported as a real finding above rather than silently corrected or waived.
